data.body: ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence, empirically reproduced): verify-session-provenance.sh walks git log BASE..HEAD (line 671) with no clean-merge exemption; the staged clean merge commit is enumerated, its only covering sub-PR is dropped by the A3b self-merge guard (line 534), so it is flagged unprovenanced -> dispatcher cannot build a non-empty net diff for a merge commit -> fail-closed at llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh:485. Fix: ported _is_clean_merge (>=2 parents AND empty git diff-tree --cc; fail-closed; evil merges not exempt) into the verifier walk, exempting clean merges before the covering-PR lookup. TDD: t15 (RED before fix - clean merge exempt), t15b (anti-laundering - unreviewed parent still flagged), t16 (evil merge still flagged). 18/18 cases; other verifier suites 35/35,2/2,5/5; shellcheck clean. Opus security review of the verifier-delta in progress.
